text: OPERATION SANDBAR — 14 ARRESTED IN HURRICANE RAFAEL DISASTER FRAUD SCHEME — December 13, 2027: The Federal Bureau of Investigation Houston Division, FBI Corpus Christi Resident Agency, and the Texas Department of Public Safety Criminal Investigations Division today announced 14 arrests in connection with a large-scale disaster fraud scheme that targeted federal disaster assistance programs and private insurers following Hurricane Rafael. The defendants, led by Corpus Christi resident Renaldo Carver-Mossbach, 44, are accused of fraudulently inflating insurance values on 230 properties before the storm and subsequently filing 187 fraudulent insurance claims and 94 fraudulent FEMA Individual Assistance applications claiming damage that did not occur or was dramatically overstated. Total alleged fraud losses exceed $23 million. Property management company Landmark Pacific Holdings LLC, water damage restoration firm FastDry Coastal LLC, and appraisal firm Duvall and Sons Property Consultants are named in the complaint. The defendants face federal charges of wire fraud, mail fraud, false statements to a federal agency, and conspiracy, carrying maximum penalties of 20 to 30 years in federal prison. FEMA has suspended 94 Individual Assistance awards pending investigation and is contacting affected applicants whose claims were filed without their knowledge. Texas DPS urges any resident who engaged with FastDry Coastal LLC or Landmark Pacific Holdings representatives after the storm to contact the Operation Sandbar tip line at (361) 555-0199.
